hero.title: A 12,000-Unit Masterplan Launch at RestateX
hero.body: Alwareef, a 12,000-unit NHC community in Southeast Jeddah, launched at RestateX with a Manzili WebGL twin, exhibition hardware and on-site launch support.

sidebar: Alwareef · NHC destination masterplan · 10M+ m² · 12,000+ residential units
WebGL masterplan twin · Exhibition touch podiums · Dual-carrier failover · RestateX launch support

challenge.title: Launching a 10M+ m² Suburb at a Packed Exhibition
challenge.body: Launching off-plan inventory across a 10M+ m² masterplan at RestateX needed reliable hardware and no network lag during heavy visitor surges.

cards.title: Exhibition Wi-Fi Blackouts
cards.body: Convention hall Wi-Fi often fails under crowd pressure, crashing cloud-only sales platforms at peak hours.

cards.title: A Masterplan Too Big for 2D
cards.body: With 12,000+ planned homes over 10M+ m², buyers struggled to picture phases, roads and amenities on flat maps.

cards.title: Double-Bookings Under Heavy Traffic
cards.body: Many consultants serving hundreds of walk-in buyers at once risk selling the same unit twice without live inventory.

solution.title: An Exhibition-Ready Setup for RestateX
solution.body: The RestateX setup paired WebGL masterplan navigation with local hardware, cellular failover and fast reservation workflows for the sales team.

blocks.label: 01 · Digital Twin
blocks.title: 10M+ m² WebGL Masterplan Twin
blocks.body: A no-download WebGL twin of all 10M+ m² of Alwareef, showing residential zones, parks, schools and highway junctions in 4K at 60 FPS.

features.title: Under 3-Second Load
features.body: On sales iPads and buyers' phones

blocks.label: 03 · Showroom Hardware
blocks.title: Exhibition Hardware & Local Computing
blocks.body: Durable touch podiums and presenter stations backed by local edge computers that run without venue internet.

features.title: Synchronized Video Walls
features.body: Consultant walkthroughs mirrored on booth screens

features.title: Plug-and-Play Assembly
features.body: Pre-configured flight cases, set up in 24 hours

blocks.label: 05 · Launch Command
blocks.title: Failover & On-Site Launch Command
blocks.body: On-site launch engineers ran local edge servers with dual-carrier private 5G failover throughout RestateX.

features.title: On-Floor Standby Engineers
features.body: Specialists in the booth for the full event

stats.label: Uptime Across 4 Exhibition Days
stats.title: No Network Downtime
stats.body: Local caching and private 5G failover kept every display running, despite venue network outages.

stats.label: Unit Lock Time
stats.title: Live Inventory Sync
stats.body: Unit holds synced in under 500 ms across every booth screen, with no double-bookings.

stats.label: Units Modeled
stats.title: Full Masterplan Scope
stats.body: Apartments, townhomes, commercial boulevards and community amenities across Alwareef.

stats.label: Rebuilds From Booth to Sales Center
stats.title: Reused After the Show
stats.body: The digital twin moved from the RestateX booth into the permanent Alwareef sales center with no rebuild.
